notes.title: Chapter 7 released!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p]I’m happy to finally bring you a [b]new update[/b] for [i]Yuri Demon[/i]![/p][p]We now have [b]Chapter 7 available[/b]. I truly hope you enjoy it![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ What's also new in this update:[/h3][p]• [b]New NSFW scene[/b] between [b]Megumi and Nicole[/b], which takes place during the meetup with Erika at the park.
  To unlock it:
  – Be on the [b]Nicole and Megumi[/b] route
  – Leave when it’s time to go, so they’re left alone
  – Accept that [b]Lilith spies on them[/b][/p][p]• [b]Improved font styles[/b], giving the text a cleaner and more polished look.[/p][p]• [b]Language selection on first launch[/b]:
  Now, when you open the game for the first time, you'll be asked whether you want to play in [b]Spanish or English[/b].
  That way, English-speaking players can enjoy the game in their language right from the beginning—no need to navigate menus in Spanish to change it.[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you so much for your support, and I hope you enjoy this new chapter.
[b]Have a great day![/b][/p]

notes.title: Yuri Demon - Secret path | Spoiler alert!
notes.content:
First of all, a heads-up: you’re going to encounter spoilers in this post. If you’d rather avoid them and discover things for yourself by playing the game, I recommend you stop reading here!

Still here? Then allow me to tell you about one of the game’s secret routes! (I say one of them because I might add more, although that’s not planned at the moment.) How do you unlock this route? Well, do you remember when Lilith asks Erika to bathe in her place? It’s an action that costs a bit of demonic power and seems to have no real impact on the game because, well, it’s just Lilith bathing and having a memory. That adds a bit more backstory for her, but... does it serve any other purpose? Yes, it does! Because if you’ve been kind to Lilith and let her bathe (and I see from the global achievement stats that, as of today, 52% of players have done so), in Chapter 7 you’ll unlock a new character. Here you can see her:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559319/d6bc3e3305d72757f430c8794b6865d5bd9f0166.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559319/11ddbf61ea577f6437d54943d7c42a7f2c555050.png[/img]
Of course, the main question you’re probably asking yourselves is who she is and what her role in the story is. Well, here comes the spoiler: she’s an angel, just like the girl Lilith slept with a long time ago, the reason the demons are after her. And just like the demons, this mysterious girl is also searching for Lilith. But why? Is she another enemy or an ally? Where will this new route take you? That, I won’t reveal haha. Partly because I still have a few details to finalize. But the secret route is here. I hope you enjoy it!

This is an idea I had for a possible sequel to the game. But, since the game is going to be so big and have so many routes that it would be difficult to make a sequel, I've decided it's best to adapt the idea to this game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559319/8b186c8233d3e13f3665ce445f89ecddafe4c5c5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559319/c36d96697af98e99ee56b7ccef00d5f3a55f5940.png[/img]
As for Chapter 7’s development itself—progress continues! I won’t be posting images of that here since this post is exclusively about the secret route. I’ll make another post in a few days with new images and news. For now, I can tell you (since this is already a spoiler-warning post) that Chapter 7 will begin with the date with Hanabi or the date with Hinata, if you accepted either one. Then certain events will unfold, and the chapter will end with one of the following dates—or with none at all: a solo date with Megumi (Megumi route), a solo date with Nicole (Nicole route), a date with both Megumi and Nicole (threesome route), or a date with Nanami (Nanami route). That’s right, quite a few dates and routes haha—so that’s why each chapter takes time to develop. But I’ll do my best to finish it as soon as possible.

Have a great day!

notes.title: About chapter 7
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This announcement is to thank all of you who are currently buying the game. In a few days, once it's approved by Steam, I’ll be releasing a demo that includes the first 3 chapters of the game.

As for chapter 7, I’m currently working on it. Since the game is getting more routes and content, the development time is increasing accordingly. Even so, I try to release one chapter per month. If I can't make it, I’ll release it the following month as soon as I can.

Here are some interesting images of what I’ve made so far for chapter 7. I hope you like them!

If you enjoy my game, please consider leaving a positive review as it will really help increase the game’s visibility and attract more players.
